Takes a finding ID (or prefix) from 'cm report' and runs the verification
		pipeline to confirm whether the finding is a real vulnerability.

After verification, the finding's status in 'cm report' is updated
(e.g., VERIFIED or DISMISSED).

Examples:
  cm verify 410f69a1                   # Verify by ID prefix
  cm verify 410f69a1-abcd-1234-...     # Verify by full UUID
  cm verify 410f69a1 --architecture=3-1 # Verify with structured thinking topology

Usage:
  cm verify [command]
Flags:
  -c, --context <text>              Additional context to guide the verification agent
  -h, --help                        help for verify
      --model string                LLM model to use (default "cm-default-model")
      --no-reset                    Suppress all workspace resets during verification
      --skip-exploit-verification   Skip running exploit script to confirm vulnerability
      --unrestricted                Disable filesystem sandbox and command policy denylist (allow agent full system access)
  -y, --yes                         Skip all confirmation prompts (commands and file writes)

Use "cm verify [command] --help" for more information about a command.
